changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdentalaction AS SELECT da.id, da.description, da.type, da.image_name, da.is_active FROM public.dental_action da;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwdentalaction TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwdentalaction FROM report_user;
